brief:
The Independent Permanent Human Rights Commission of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation condemned escalating violence by Israeli settlers against Palestinian civilians across occupied Palestinian territory, Shehab Wire reported. The commission said the attacks have intensified throughout the West Bank and other occupied areas, affecting residents in multiple locations.

The body called for immediate international intervention to halt what it characterized as systematic violations against the Palestinian population. The commission's statement underscores mounting concern among regional rights organizations over settler violence targeting civilians in the occupied territories.
